title: Business automation in Tajikistan — CRM system | shamCRM

facts.fact: shamCRM states that 120+ companies already work in its system in Tajikistan.
shamCRM offers a 14-day demo for businesses in Tajikistan.
shamCRM's Tajikistan page links to its plans and states that plans are priced in TJS (Tajikistani somoni).
According to shamCRM's Tajikistan page, leads in Tajikistan come from Instagram, WhatsApp, Telegram, and Facebook.
facts.quote: In Tajikistan the whole business runs in shamCRM: leads from Instagram, WhatsApp, Telegram, and Facebook, calls, team tasks, the warehouse, and the cash desk.

facts.fact: shamCRM states that a missed call is automatically turned into a task so the client can be called back.
facts.quote: A missed call becomes a task, so nobody forgets to call the client back.
